name: Quests Engine
author: ct
description: Engine quests subsystem: the quest factory and runtime state (QuestFactory, QuestBase/QuestData), the IQuestService implementation, quest scenario actions, quest scene conditions with the QuestParser leaf parser and the quest journal UI. Replaces the former Core/Quests state, Core/Actions quest services and actions, Core/Scenes quest conditions and Core/UI/Quests - QuestsModInitializer publishes the kernel contract (IQuestService via QuestServiceRegistry), registers the quest leaf parser and the new-game resettable; QuestsSaveable persists quest state through the generic mod save slot.
